title: S4-LAYER-03 — Blend and opacity keep their neighbors.
goal: Blend modes and opacity composite exactly as their formulas say. Fixture replay: Base Layer filled #4080c0, Layer 2 filled #c08040. Expected composites are computed independently: Normal #c08040, Multiply a*b/255 = #304030, Screen 255-(255-a)(255-b)/255 = #d0c0d0, Normal at 50% opacity = #808080 within one 8-bit step per channel. Changing modes never edits either layer.

steps.why: Normal blending shows the upper layer.
Back to Normal, the composite is exactly the original.
Half opacity mixes 64/192 and 128/128 halfway to 128 in red, green and blue; 8-bit canvas compositing may land one step away (Chromium gives #80807f).
Full opacity restores the exact composite: neither layer was edited.

uncovered: Overlay, Color Dodge and On artwork only against native RGBA
